anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), which is unusual given there are no active trades.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, zero average confidence, and no opportunities generated, indicating potential issues with AI functionality or configuration.
Trading metrics show zero total profit/loss and zero ROI despite having closed trades, which might indicate issues with trade execution or reporting.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential system slowdowns or failures.
Review and enhance AI module configuration or algorithms to ensure it is actively learning and generating opportunities.
Audit trade execution and reporting processes to ensure accurate reflection of trading activities.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, affecting platform performance and user experience.
